title: Choose the visual world for SidePlay
question: The roll assigned Dispatch Carton. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Dispatch Carton
options.lineage: Stockroom cartons and shipping labels: the 'brown box with colorful poster' every catalog item ships in
options.thesis: Every product is a labelled carton on SidePlay's shelf; ordering is printing its dispatch slip to WhatsApp.
materials: black corrugated board (kraft translated to the logo's black)
options.viewport: Red tape strip as nav; huge carton-marking headline; a shelf of seven department cartons with counts and from-prices; one featured label with barcode, price and Order on WhatsApp.
options.risk: Reads as a warehouse, not play, unless real product photos and color carry the joy; carton marking must stay industrial, never army-stencil.

raised.raise: Every label carries the same fixed readout set (price, size, age/load, code) in the same position on every product.
Every carton is addressable by its real item code: #JC-5320ST opens that product.
A closed palette: tape red, steel, black board, label white. No other colour enters except product photos.
Variants set as lettered views A/B/C; the chosen colour/size prints solid, the rest stay dashed.
Spec callouts drawn onto the product photo: a leader line from the label to the rim, wheel or capacity that matters.

options.label: Sports Hall
options.lineage: School and club sports halls: varnished floor, painted court lines, the wall scoreboard
options.thesis: The store laid out as one court: each department is a zone painted on the floor, prices on the scoreboard.
options.viewport: Top-down court; the centre circle holds the headline, zones (key, baseline, sideline) hold departments; scoreboard header shows the WhatsApp number.
options.risk: Familiar sporty move many sports stores reach for; the wood ground competes with the black logo.

options.label: Hand-drawn Zine
options.thesis: Products explained like a friend sketching on a napkin.
options.viewport: Marker headline over a doodled scooter with arrows to its parts.
options.case: Fuses poorly: cream paper erases the binding red/steel/black logo; shoppers want prices, not lessons.
options.kept: Spec callouts drawn onto the product photo.
options.risk: Childish for fitness and outdoor buyers.

options.label: Night Instrument Panel
options.thesis: Six calm dials, each owning one truth.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nobody shops for goals and tents through gauges; clarity collapses.
options.kept: A fixed readout set in the same position on every product.

options.label: Teletext Mosaic
options.thesis: The catalog as numbered broadcast pages.
options.viewport: P100 index, departments as page numbers.
options.case: Fuses partly (item codes as page numbers) but product photos cannot live in a block grid; loses clarity and identification.
options.kept: Every product addressable by its item code.

options.label: Collective Plate
options.thesis: A shared symbol set in a fixed palette.
options.viewport: Hard-edged figures floating over a flat ground.
options.case: Fuses poorly: cobalt, magenta and lemon break the logo; art-gallery register.
options.kept: A closed palette with no exceptions.

options.label: Pattern Envelope
options.thesis: Views A, B, C and a size table on the back.
options.viewport: Envelope front with lettered views of a product.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a craft world foreign to sport.
options.kept: Variants as lettered views, chosen one solid.

options.label: Sleeping City Fold
options.thesis: A night city folding into a quilt.
options.case: Fuses poorly: dreamy and slow where shoppers want price and action.
options.kept: Departments read as districts of one continuous place.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark sporty online store: action banner, category tiles, product grid, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Full-width action banner with a headline and shop button, then a row of category tiles.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other sports shop by design.
